title: workspace config
description: Settings of the workspace module: publish-safety limits, the git lock and the plans migrator. Machine-wide: a project file cannot set them.

publish.description: Limits of publish-safety (what may enter the workspace git).

max_tracked_bytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes stay local-only (not in git).

max_binary_tracked_bytes.description: Binary files larger than this many bytes stay local-only (not in git).

lock_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the workspace git lock before WORKSPACE_GIT_LOCKED.

plans_migrator.description: Id of the bridge that fills the plans-migrator extension point.
